proposals.before: Just then the Xiongnu had struck deep into Chaona and slain Sun Ang, the commandant of Beidi.
proposals.after: Just then the Xiongnu had struck deep into Chaona and slain Ang, the commandant of Beidi.
proposals.reason: Chinese names only 卬 (Ang); idiomatic invents the surname Sun not present in the source.

proposals.before: As grand minister of agriculture he let contractors use his clients as labor; the accounts fell deep into arrears.
proposals.after: As grand minister of agriculture, he entrusted men and his retainers took hire-contracts; much of the revenue fell into arrears.
proposals.reason: Chinese 任人賓客僦 means he employed/entrusted people and guests engaged in hire-leasing, not that contractors used his clients as labor.

proposals.before: Gaozu ordered all former ministers of Xiang Yu to name Yu [by his personal name as contempt]; Lord Zheng alone did not comply with the edict.
proposals.after: Gaozu ordered all former ministers of Xiang Yu to call Yu by his personal name; Lord Zheng alone did not comply with the edict.
proposals.reason: Bracketed editorial gloss is not in the Chinese and makes the literal line unnatural; 名籍 is simply to name him 籍.

decisions.reason: This chapter writes only 卬, but the Beidi commandant is 孫卬: Shiji 惠景間侯者年表 records 北地都尉孫卬, and Xu Guang on the Xiongnu biography notes 姓孫. Supplying the surname is historically accurate, not an invention from this line alone.

decisions.after: As grand minister of agriculture, he entrusted men with the work and his retainers engaged in hire-contracts; much of the revenue fell into arrears.
decisions.reason: 任人賓客僦 means he entrusted/appointed people and his guests engaged in hire-leasing, not that contractors used his clients as labor; the proposal corrects the agency but is awkward, so the idiomatic is restated more naturally while keeping 入多逋負 as revenue arrears.
名籍 is simply to call Xiang Yu by his personal name 籍; the bracketed gloss “as contempt” is not in the Chinese and does not belong in the literal field.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 高祖令諸故項籍臣名籍
